user.title: Media Time Guard – Person
user.description: Create a media-time budget for one person. Bind to a person entity if available, otherwise just enter a name (e.g. for children without a person entity).

budgets.title: Daily budgets
budgets.description: Minutes of media time per weekday. 0 means blocked on that day.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Optional one-time warning before the budget runs out. The TTS fields apply when method is TTS; the media fields apply when method is Media.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Time of day at which the daily count is reset.

error.player_in_use: At least one selected media player is already assigned to another person.
error.no_players: Select at least one media player.
error.tts_entity_required: Choose a TTS engine when the warning method is TTS.
error.media_id_required: Enter a media content ID when the warning method is Media.
